With today's new release, users of the SmartGym iPhone app will find it easier to adjust and log sets during their workouts. Here's what's new.

SmartGym makes adjusting and logging sets during workouts easier

SmartGym's Apple Watch app has long allowed users to quickly adjust details like reps and weight while logging each set.

With today's update, that flexibility extends to the iPhone app. Users can now choose between the existing logging interface and a brand new "inline logging" interface, which lets you adjust values, log a set, and add a set without ever leaving the same screen.

The new interface also adds a small marker in the bottom right of the rep and weight fields that shows what each set was originally planned for.

After you finish logging a set, SmartGym will also kick off the rest timer right on the same screen, so you can keep your workout going without switching views.

Here's the thing from SmartGym:

This matters because SmartGym isn't just about logging what you did, it's about helping you understand what you were supposed to do. Your training plan is there to move you toward your goals. Putting the planned sets alongside the actual sets makes it easier to stay on track during a workout, and easier to see if you're improving over time.

This update also introduces an entirely redesigned keyboard built from the ground up to make logging during a workout smoother. The keyboard features buttons to quickly increase or decrease values, or switch between set types like regular, warmup, and drop sets.

As SmartGym puts it: "Every second we save in the app is a second you can put toward the thing that matters most—your workout."

Finally, today's update also includes a redesigned "Smart Action Button" that predicts what you're most likely to do next, and based on where you are in your workout, shows the corresponding action in the bottom of the interface.

Options include "Log set and start rest," "Start exercise," "First set of superset," "Update set," "Next exercise," and "Finish workout," among others.

SmartGym says they've also improved the smarts behind the Smart Action Button:

The result is a feature that feels more natural. SmartGym quietly handles the complex stuff in the background, and you only see what you need, when you need it.

One last thing: users can set the iPhone's physical Action Button to trigger SmartGym's Smart Action Button, making it faster to manage your workout without even touching the app.

SmartGym is a free download on the App Store, with a variety of subscription plans.
